programme.title: America's Most Haunted City
programme.desc: In 2002, the world's most funded, field research organization, The American Institute of Parapsychology, doted its highest honorarium, "America's Most Haunted City," on Savannah, Georgia, leaving many to ask, "What The Haunted?" With this documentary, 20 year, paranormal insider, Shannon Scott, addresses his own views of Savannah's long haunted heritage and through Scott's own unique lens, attempts to convey a message about this side of life in the city that millions of people visit annually because of its ghostly and mysterious reputation. Scott, having worked for the likes of "Scariest Places On Earth," "Ghosthunters," and others, captures discussion with real Savannahians, about what it really means to live long term with phenomenon such as poltergeist, spook lights, shadow people, and other moments with the unexplained. Shannon Scott fully narrates and the film is a combination of stunning visuals of historic Savannah and surrounding Low Country, and includes an extensive interview with Dr. Andrew Nichols, founder of The American Institute of Parapsychology, about his life's work and his perceptions about what led him to crowning Savannah, America's Most Haunted City!

programme.title: Classic Canadian Sasquatch Stories
programme.desc: For as long as human beings have braved the mountain passes and rugged trails of the Canadian Rockies, stories have been told of a huge, elusive, man-like creature that haunts the slopes. Though scarcer and more obscure than its famous West Coast counterpart, this mysterious alpine monster has nonetheless found its way into foundational ethnological treatises on Canada’s First Nations, and into seminal works on the Sasquatch phenomenon. In this episode, we will delve into classic legends of and encounters with the wildman of the Canadian Rockies.

programme.title: Classic Canadian Sasquatch Stories

We finish up with Cheryl Boglioli and a 3D sculpture using an interesting medium to create a female form reminiscent of modernism.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Adventure All Stars is the world’s only socially conscious travel show – an inspiring series that combines adventure and philanthropy. Cast members travel to secret locations, to uncover the best and most exciting experiences on the planet! Pre-filming all cast members raise funds for their favorite charitable cause, and their reward is the trip-of-a-lifetime. The show contributes more to charity than any other Australian television series, and is now one of the biggest donors to philanthropy of any TV show in the world (almost $10 Million).

programme.title: The Colours of China
programme.desc: Five colours are an integral part of contemporary China and the ancient philosophy of Wu Xing. Each episode takes us to regions where we meet our characters, learn how Wu Xing sits in their lives and explore the landscapes they live in.

programme.title: Edible Nutmeg: On the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, we follow Chef Plum on the road as he visits Oui Charcuterie in Woodbridge, Connecticut along with CT Style co-host Ryan Kristafer to learn all about how they make their iconic, traditional salamis.

programme.title: Along the Mississippi
programme.desc: Revisit the darker parts of US history, the times of slavery on plantations in the southern states.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Philadelphia, otherwise known as the City of Brotherly Love. From learning how it all began with our founding fathers at the Constitution Center to experiencing the original Philly Cheesesteak at the place that created it, we explore and live like a lcoal in Philly.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover why they call it Home Sweet Alabama with an inside peak in Huntsville! Featuring a behind the scenes look at the US Space & Rocket Center then we discover the haunted spots of downtown with a mysterious ghost walk, then ending the day with some famous Pecan Pie.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Katonah, NY starting out the day with fresh farm & country at the Harvest Moon Orchard all while enjoying a local car show. We discover the history of Katonah from those who know it best and end our day with beautiful music at Caramoor.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We learn why Bowling Green is the corvette capital with a behind the scenes look at the world famous corvette museum! From there we zoom our way with corvette test drive on the race track and then head to some caves to explore the unknown. We end our day with some fresh made ice cream at Chaney's Dairy Barn.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore the Outer Banks. Starting the day out at the beach discovering wild horses. From there we go to the National Wright Brothers Monument where the first fliights took place. We top off our day visiting some historic lighthouse and some local cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We enjoy a day to kayaking in this beautiful naval neighborhood. We learn first hand from local historians the rich history of Annapolis and of adventure in Annapolis. Starting out the day with some great eat from the famous Chick n' Ruths top off the day at the annual Crab Fest!

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: Memphis-the birthplace of Rock n' Roll. We see it all in Memphis from the famous Sun studio where the legends record to the home of one of the most iconic legends him - Elvis's Graceland. We top off our day with some amazing and real deal BBQ spot on world famous Beale Street.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Travel to Zurich, Switzerland, Europe's undisputed capital of finance, where you and Donna will enjoy the city's history, culture, cuisine, and high-end shopping in what is an extremely clean and cosmopolitan city.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The rocks that make up the treeless landscape of the Shetland Islands are some of the oldest rock formations in the world. Three seas flow together here, making the waters treacherous and unpredicatble, but the island's stunning wildlife remains largely untouched.

programme.desc: Ocean inspired art from Anh Pham & some crazy little tacos

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Transylvania is the fabled home of Dracula and the setting for all sorts of frightening, and mostly, fictional tales. Rob & crew uncover the real Transylvania on a road trip through striking landscapes dotted with old farmhouses and rural villages full of friendly folks, many who live as they did centuries ago.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Travel to Zurich, Switzerland, Europe's undisputed capital of finance, where you and Donna will enjoy the city's history, culture, cuisine, and high-end shopping in what is an extremely clean and cosmopolitan city.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This town has a train running right through the middle of it! The guys check into a luxurious estate near La Grange then check out how some of the world's finest bourbon is made, meet some incredible horse ladies and tour a famous baseball factory.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick road trip to Havre de Grace, a picturesque waterfront town on the banks of the Susquehanna River. They sample the best of creole cuisine, get hands on in the decoy business, experience the Chesapeake and even crack crabs with the mayor.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and "Captain" Nick explore this beautiful riverboat town. First stop, the iconic Lafayette Hotel. Next, they see firsthand how to make history on a stick then indulge in some local craft brews. Also, a special encounter with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Join Nick and Brian as they discover the true beauty of Greenbrier County. After settling in downtown Lewisburg, they explore Cold War secrets, birds of prey, an awesome river trail and go deep into the earth. They also meet a new friend named Marcel.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: The boys roll into Delaware and are on a historical quest for gunpowder! Cannons, battle axes, historic houses and a cozy tavern will also be explored on their journey.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick travel to the coal regions of PA and experience fantastic food and outdoor adventure. They eat ups and downs, go off-roading, roll 1800 feet into the side of a mountain and learn all about making pierogies and kielbasy.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick roll down along the Delaware River to explore several small river towns including the Victorian village known as Frenchtown NJ. Ride along as they check out exotic cars, the sport of fencing, and a bacon festival near their hometown.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick cruise into Cape May County where the Caddy is a special guest at Oktoberfest! They'll stay at The Chalfonte Hotel, visit an aviation museum and head out to Diamond Beach and visit a iconic phone booth that changed a magazine forever.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick and Brian road trip to apple country where they meet the Apple Queen and some real thirsty farmers. They find a tranquil B&B just outside of Gettysburg then visit a tavern built in 1776. They wind up in a wild west gunfight heading out of town.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick and Brian cruise up to a place known for its alluring natural rock ledges and waterfalls. They head to Trout Town USA to try their hand at fly fishing. Then road trip back in time to the historical site of the legendary Woodstock music festival.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and "Captain" Nick explore this beautiful riverboat town. First stop, the iconic Lafayette Hotel. Next, they see firsthand how to make history on a stick then indulge in some local craft brews. Also, a special encounter with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Join Nick and Brian as they discover the true beauty of Greenbrier County. After settling in downtown Lewisburg, they explore Cold War secrets, birds of prey, an awesome river trail and go deep into the earth. They also meet a new friend named Marcel.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Separated by less than an hour or so by boat via the famous Danube you’ll find two major cities that, though proximate to each other, could not be more different. Not long ago, Bratislava and Vienna were at the edge, but opposite ends of the fabled Iron Curtain, which divided much more than just ideology. The crew explores the resulting and fascinating contrasts recent history has imposed, but mostly, shows travelers how they can have a good time appreciating the very different charms of each city.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Soccer legend Cobi Jones joins Donna and her daughter for fun and adventure in Phuket, Thailand.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The Isle of Man lies in the midst of the Irish Sea between Ireland and England. Officially, it belongs to the Queen, yet it has its own laws and its own currency. Its crest is the 'three legs' that symbolise its resilient people. The island holds a fascinating history of Viking settlement.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History is a unique, Emmy nominated travel series that explores diverse cities and historical sites around the World while experiencing the cultural and archaeological features of these unique locations. From the oldest building in the Western Hemisphere to the famous French Quarter, a spectacular chain of islands off the Southern coast of Florida to the birthplace of California, the Travel Thru History series is a must see to learn about America's rich and fascinating history by traveling to amazing cities across the states. It explores diverse cities and historical sites while experiencing the cultural and archaeological features of these unique locations.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!
